# Vote.gov

> > Official U.S. government website providing voter registration information, state-specific voting guides, and resources for all eligible voters.

Vote.gov serves as the federal government's centralized platform for voter registration and election information. The site helps citizens navigate state-specific voting requirements, register to vote, request absentee ballots, and access resources for military members, voters with disabilities, and those with felony convictions.

## Key Topics

- voter-registration
- voting-rights
- election-guide
- absentee-voting
- voter-id
- military-voting

- early-voting
- polling-locations

## Voter Registration & Core Resources

- [Register to vote in your state | Vote.gov](https://vote.gov/): Official US government voter registration homepage with state-specific guides
